records.title: Active-site stabilized Bi metal–organic framework-based catalyst for highly active and selective electroreduction of CO2 to formate over a wide potential window
records.titleZh: Bi-BDC 活性位点与原位重构
records.titleEn: Bi-BDC active sites and in situ reconstruction
records.summaryZh: 研究 Bi-BDC 电还原 CO₂ 制甲酸盐。摘要将长期运行表现与原位生成的 Bi₂O₂CO₃ 保留 Bi–O 位点联系起来，不能将运行中活性相直接视为初始 MOF。
records.summaryEn: Studies formate production using Bi-BDC. The abstract links long-term operation to reconstructed Bi₂O₂CO₃ retaining Bi–O sites; the operating phase must be distinguished from the initial MOF.
records.keywords: Bi-BDC Bi2O2CO3 重构 甲酸盐 CO2 formate reconstruction

records.title: MOF-derived Bi@NC electrocatalysts with heteroatomic engineering for high-efficiency CO2-to-formate conversion
records.titleZh: MOF 衍生 Bi@NC 与氮掺杂碳
records.summaryZh: 通过铋基 MOF 热解制备氮掺杂碳负载铋纳米颗粒，研究界面调控与 CO₂ 制甲酸盐。该体系属于 MOF 衍生材料，不能沿用前驱体的结构身份。
records.summaryEn: Pyrolysis of a Bi MOF produces bismuth nanoparticles supported on nitrogen-doped carbon for CO₂-to-formate conversion. This is a derived catalyst; precursor structure identity cannot be assigned to the active material.
records.keywords: Bi@NC 热解 氮掺杂 衍生 甲酸盐 CO2 formate nitrogen

records.title: An acid-tolerant metal-organic framework for industrial CO2 electrolysis using a proton exchange membrane
records.titleZh: 耐酸 Bi-TDC 与质子交换膜电解
records.summaryZh: 研究耐酸 Bi-TDC@DMF 在酸性 CO₂ 电解中的应用，并结合质子交换膜装置制取甲酸。流动池与膜电解装置须分别记录条件；出版社标注存在作者更正（2024-10-02），使用前需同时查阅。
records.summaryEn: Examines acid-tolerant Bi-TDC@DMF and a proton-exchange-membrane device for formic acid production. Flow-cell and membrane-device conditions must remain separate. The publisher flags an Author Correction dated 2024-10-02; consult it alongside the article.
records.keywords: Bi-TDC DMF 耐酸 质子交换膜 甲酸 PEM CO2 formic acid acid-tolerant

records.title: Ligand-Modulated Bismuth Metal–Organic Frameworks for Efficient Formate Production by Solar-Driven Coelectrolysis of CO2 and Methanol
records.titleZh: 配体调控 Bi-MOF 与太阳能耦合电解
records.summaryZh: 比较不同配体构筑的铋基 MOF，讨论配体结构对 CO₂ 电还原的影响，并探索与甲醇氧化耦合的太阳能电解。当前收录出版社摘要线索，运行条件与数值尚待逐项核对。
records.summaryEn: Compares bismuth MOFs built with different ligands and explores solar-driven CO₂/methanol coelectrolysis. This entry captures the publisher abstract; operating conditions and numeric claims await field-level review.
records.keywords: Bi-BDC Bi-BTC Bi-PMA 配体 太阳能 甲醇 甲酸盐 CO2 methanol solar ligand
